home.headline: stay a while
home.introduction:
Hey,
I am Joshua.
Welcome to my world!

Here you find everything that shapes me: My favorite quotes and my thoughts about them, a hologram of our beautiful planet with my favorite places and in the future there will be so much more.

Have fun exploring.
